description: One allowed e-mail domain of a corporate provider exception (G-160). The domain is proven by a DNS TXT record. Only the record name is kept, not its value.

fields.label: Domain
fields.description: Lowercase full domain name. No wildcard, no public mail domain.

fields.label: Verification Method
fields.description: How the organisation proved that it owns the domain. Only a DNS TXT record is accepted.

fields.label: Verified On
fields.description: When the DNS TXT record was checked. It must be before the approval.

fields.label: Verification Record
fields.description: The name of the DNS TXT record. Its value is not written here.
